nodes.name: Proposition 3.1: linkcolor=black Disentanglement
nodes.statement:
Let $T>0$ and $\mu_0^i\in\mathscr{P}(\mathbb{Q}_1^{d-1})$, $i\in[N]$, be given.
There exists $\theta\in L^\infty((0,T);\Uptheta)$ such that
\begin{equation*}
    \mathrm{conv}_g\, \mathrm{supp}(\mu^i(T))\cap \mathrm{conv}_g \,\mathrm{supp}(\mu^j(T))=\varnothing
\end{equation*}
for all $i\neq j\in[N]$, where $\mu^i \in \mathscr{C}^0([0,T];\mathscr{P}(\mathbb{S}^{d-1}))$ denotes the unique solution to (1.4)--(3.1) corresponding to $\mu_0^i$ and $\theta$. 

Furthermore, we can take $\theta$ to be piecewise constant, having $O(d\cdot N)$ switches.
